promptVersions.body:
Everyone likes a time-saver. Enter the SMS Template.


With SMS Templates, you can create one-off templated messages with Contact or Lead merge fields for text messages, such as:


  • Hi {{FirstName}}, it's your counselor, {{Counselor_Name__c}}. Feel free to text me here at any time with questions.
  • Hi, it's Jen - your advisor. It looks like we're missing a few documents to complete your application. Please text me back at your convenience so that we can finish your application.
  • The next event is being held on {{DateTime_Field__c}}. Don't miss it! Contact Rob for more information.


To create a basic SMS Template:

  1. Select New
  2. Name your SMS Template, such as: Counselor Introduction
  3. Type your message into the Text field
  4. Save


NOTE: When utilizing Contact or Lead merge fields, be sure that they're configured in Application Settings


In addition, SMS Templates may also be the start of an automated conversation or survey (Form Template):

  1. After creating your Form Template and setting its Status to Active, copy the exact message text of your First Question.
  2. Navigate to the SMS Templates tab and select New
  3. Name your SMS Template, such as: Student Survey
  4. Paste the message text into the Text field
  5. Select the accompanying Form Template in the Form Template lookup
  6. Save


Your newly-created SMS Templates will now be available via the drop-downs in Conversation View and in Bulk SMS. Simply select the SMS Template, and your message will appear in the text field.
